info.title: Lisimflix API
info.description: Public HTTP contract. M1 (CTR-1): one authorised viewer plays one original MP4. CTR-2 adds the catalogue, user-data, profile and metadata-provenance shapes. Each operation's x-lisimflix names its owning feature and whether it is implemented or still planned. All /api/v1 responses are private and sent with Cache-Control: no-store. Unsafe browser operations require X-CSRF-Token. Login/logout/session behaviour belongs to the runtime (OPS-1/ACC-1); playback sessions and content belong to PLY-2. Source paths, password hashes, cookies and grants never appear in response bodies other than the grant inside contentUrl.

get.summary: Current auth state; anonymous callers get authenticated:false, viewer:null and a CSRF token

post.summary: Sign in; rotates the session cookie and issues a fresh CSRF token
Sign out; removes the cookie and revokes the auth session and its playback sessions

get.summary: Movies the viewer may play (M1: only the configured movie)

post.summary: Start playback. Replaying the same key and payload for an active session returns 200 with that session. The same key with a changed payload, or the key of a session that ended recently (its record is kept for 5 minutes), is 409 idempotency_conflict: start again with a new key.
Keep a live owned session alive; expired sessions return 410 and are not revived

get.summary: Original MP4 bytes, never transformed. Needs both the user cookie and the signed grant.

200.description: Whole file with Accept-Ranges: bytes, Content-Length, ETag and Last-Modified of the original

head.summary: Headers of the original MP4 (length, ranges, validators) without a body

put.summary: Mark a movie or episode watched (origin manual) or unwatched for the current profile. Marking unwatched resets the item: watched and resume become null, so the next play starts from the beginning and finishing it marks it watched again (origin auto). expectedRevision must equal the current UserItemState.revision, otherwise 409 revision_conflict and nothing changes.

post.summary: Report progress for an owned live session. A duplicate or out-of-order sequence is 200 with accepted:false. A session whose source changed is 409 source_changed; an ended session is 410.

get.summary: Libraries the current profile may see
Genres, year range, audio languages, resolutions and an HDR flag present in the library's permitted items; fills the filter menus. 404 for a library the profile may not see.
Movies and episodes with resume, not watched, not hidden; newest lastPlayedAt first. total is null.
Next Up row: one episode per show the profile has started. total is null.
get.description: For each show the profile has started, the first unwatched episode after the last watched one, in the library's order. A show with an episode in progress (a resume point) is skipped: that episode is in Continue Watching. Specials are never inserted.

get.summary: Items the current profile may see, sorted by sort (default title). Pass exactly one of libraryId (the library's movies or shows) or parentId (a show's seasons or a season's episodes, in the chosen order); otherwise 400 invalid_request. from without sort=title, any filter with parentId, and any combination the server can't apply (including watched until DATA-1 is live, or yearFrom greater than yearTo) are also 400 invalid_request. A library or parent the profile may not see is 404.
get.description: Title collation is fixed in the contract: titles compare by sortTitle folded with META-1a's Normalize (META-1a plan (#121), decision 6), so sorting, the A–Z jump and matching all compare titles the same way. The fold: lower case; Latin accents folded with a built-in table (é → e, ß → ss, æ → ae), and a combining mark dropped only after a Latin letter (#123); & → "and"; other punctuation becomes a space and spaces collapse; a leading "the", "a" or "an" is dropped when more words follow. Other scripts compare as written. So Élite sorts and jumps as elite. Sorting with sort=title puts the # group first (folded sortTitle not starting with a–z, including non-Latin titles, which compare as written within the group), then a–z; within each group items sort by folded sortTitle, and ties break by item ID. from (A–Z jump): one letter A–Z or #, only valid with sort=title. A letter starts the page at the first item whose folded sortTitle begins with that letter or a later one. # covers every item whose folded sortTitle doesn't start with a–z: digits, symbols and non-Latin titles such as Japanese. These sort before A, so # is the first page. Send # percent-encoded as %23. Filters (genre, yearFrom, yearTo, resolution, hdr, audioLanguage, watched) apply only to libraryId listings. audioLanguage uses ISO 639-2/T (deu, fra, zho); the producer maps /B tags (ger, fre, chi) to /T so German is listed once. total is set on the first page (no cursor) of a listing and is null on later pages.

get.summary: One item with its versions and streams. META-1 fills the descriptive fields and DATA-1 the user state.
Admin only: the item's metadata with provenance and locks. Non-admins get 404.

sessionCookie.name: lisimflix_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax session cookie; Secure when served over HTTPS

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Token from AuthState.csrfToken; mismatch is 403 csrf_failed

Grant.name: grant
Grant.description: Signature bound to playback ID, auth session, account/profile, movie and source revision; not authority without the live session

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; opaque

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: title: A→Z; added and year: newest first

From.name: from
From.description: A–Z jump; only with sort=title. Send # percent-encoded as %23.

HDR.name: hdr
HDR.description: true: HDR only; false: SDR only; omitted: no filter

Watched.name: watched
Watched.description: Reads DATA-1's data; 400 invalid_request until DATA-1 is live

Error.description: Error. 400 invalid_request, 401 unauthenticated, 403 csrf_failed, 404 not_found (unknown or not owned), 409 source_changed, idempotency_conflict (reused key with a different body, or the key of a session that ended recently; start again with a fresh key) or revision_conflict (expectedRevision is not the current revision; reload and retry), 410 playback_expired, 429 rate_limited or capacity_unavailable, 500 internal_error, 503 source_unavailable.

contentUrl.description: Same-origin relative URL carrying the grant

UserItemState.description: The current profile's state for one movie or episode. revision counts committed changes (0 = nothing recorded yet); writes send it back as expectedRevision.

watched.description: Null: not watched yet, or reset by marking unwatched

playCount.description: Null when unknown, e.g. after an import that had no count

Resume.description: A resume position on one version's timeline. A different version or source revision needs confirmation before the position is reused.

Watched.description: Watched state and where it came from. A manual watched mark is never undone by later playback. Marking unwatched is a reset (watched and resume become null), not a sticky value:false.

ProgressEvent.description: One progress report for a live playback session, sent every 10 s and on pause, seek and stop. The session fixes the item, version and source revision. sequence increases within a session.

fromPositionMs.description: Seeks only: the position before the seek

ProgressResult.description: A duplicate or stale event is answered with accepted:false and the unchanged state, not an error.

availability.description: All, some or none of the library's source folders are readable. Folder paths are never sent to viewers. degraded (a scan failed part-way) is an admin scan state, not a viewer one (UI-6, LIB-2c).

LibraryScan.description: Scan progress for the first scan (decision 6; LIB-2b records the counters). When state is idle (no first scan running), filesSeen is 0 and filesTotal is null. When both are known, filesSeen <= filesTotal.

LibraryFacets.description: Filter-menu values present in the library's items the profile may see. audioLanguages use ISO 639-2/T.

years.description: Null when no item has a year. min <= max.

sdr.description: Any SDR item is present; tells the client whether an SDR-only filter has matches

ContentRating.description: A certification in one rating region, e.g. AU PG. Ratings from different regions are not comparable.

ItemSummary.description: A logical catalogue item. IDs are opaque and survive renames, provider changes and episode-order changes. title is already in the current profile's title language (spec §3.2). Unknown values are null. Decision 1: viewers see titles and version labels, never file names (MediaVersion.fileName is admin-only). Decision 7: addedAt, childCount, showTitle, seasonIndex and available are LIB-2's; matched is META-1's.

parentId.description: Season: its show. Episode: its season. Null for movies and shows.

index.description: Season or episode number in the library's chosen order (0 = specials). Null for movies and shows, or when unknown.

durationMs.description: Default version's duration. Null for shows and seasons, or when unknown.

primaryImageUrl.description: Poster, or an episode's still. Same-origin relative URL.

userState.description: The current profile's state. Null for shows and seasons.

addedAt.description: When the item entered the library; sort=added orders by it

childCount.description: Seasons of a show, episodes of a season, counting only children the profile may see (no leaks through counts); null for movies and episodes.

showTitle.description: Set on episodes and seasons; null for movies and shows. Mixed rows read "[Show] · S1 E4" from this and seasonIndex.

seasonIndex.description: The episode's season number (0 = specials); null when unknown, and null for non-episodes.

matched.description: META-1: null means matching hasn't run (all items until META-1 lands). Only false shows the Unmatched badge.

available.description: True if any version can play, false shows a File offline badge. Null for shows and seasons.

total.description: Items after permission and filters (no leaks through counts). An integer on the first page of a listItems call (no cursor); null on later pages and for continue-watching and next-up.

ExternalId.description: A provider ID in its namespace, e.g. tmdb 603. The item's kind says which of the provider's ID spaces it belongs to.

ItemDetail.description: Decision 7: communityRating, directors and studios are META-1's. Version file names are admin-only (decision 1).

versions.description: Playable versions. Empty for shows and seasons, and for a movie or episode with no available file.

MediaVersion.description: One playable version (cut or quality) of a movie or episode, backed by one file. Episodes that share a file have the same fileId; segment locates the episode when its boundaries are known.

label.description: e.g. Director's Cut. Null when the item has one unnamed version.

sourceRevision.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of fileId, size and modification time (contracts.SourceRevision). Changes exactly when the file's size or modification time changes.

container.description: ffprobe format name, e.g. mov,mp4,m4a,3gp,3g2,mj2 or matroska,webm

available.description: False when the version's source folder is offline or its file is missing; Play on it shows File offline without starting a session.

fileName.description: Bare file name, admins only; null for other viewers. Never a path.

Segment.description: A range of the file's media timeline; endMs is after startMs.

index.description: Original stream index in the file

profile.description: ffprobe profile, e.g. LC, Dolby TrueHD + Dolby Atmos, DTS-HD MA. Null when none is reported.

language.description: ISO 639-2 as tagged; null when untagged or und

ProfilePolicy.description: Effective policy: the account's ceiling narrowed by the profile. For display; the server enforces policy on every request.

libraryIds.description: Libraries this profile may see. Empty means none.

ratingCeiling.description: Highest allowed rating in its region. Null: no rating limit. A rating from another region counts as unrated.

ItemMetadata.description: Admin view of an item's editable metadata with provenance. revision starts at 1 and counts committed changes.

Provenance.description: Where a value came from: a provider namespace (tmdb, tvdb, anilist ...), nfo for local NFO files, or user for manual edits.
